odc_type: Index out of bounds due to incorrect array size calculation
observation_summary: The application throws an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException when calling getCovariances() or guessParametersErrors() on a problem containing bound parameters.
reasoning_summary: The code attempted to iterate over the Jacobian matrix using the total number of parameters (all parameters) instead of the number of unbound parameters. Since the Jacobian is only computed for unbound parameters, the size of the Jacobian array is smaller than the total number of parameters. This mismatch caused an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException when the loop index exceeded the actual bounds of the Jacobian array. The fix correctly updates the logic to use the count of unbound parameters, ensuring the iteration bounds match the actual data structure size.
